web/src/config.ts is the reader and documents every field; this is the shape, with Steve's own project id left out.
Nothing here is secret. A Firebase web API key is a public identifier — the database rules and the desktop's uid
check are what gate anything — which is why it is safe to serve beside the bundle rather than baked into it.
